prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on your goals. That said, these are the top options (mid‑2024) and when to pick each:

Top picks and when to use them
- Synthesia (or Elai/HeyGen for similar features)
  - Best for: realistic AI presenters / on‑camera spokespersons from text.
  - Strengths: many avatar voices/languages, fast script → finished video, brand kit.
  - Limits: less creative control over cinematic effects; higher cost for lots of minutes.

- Runway
  - Best for: creative, generative visuals (text→video, background replacement, advanced editing).
  - Strengths: powerful generative models, frame‑accurate editing, great for attention‑grabbing ads.
  - Limits: learning curve; credit‑based pricing for generative renders.

- Canva (Video) / InVideo / Promo / FlexClip
  - Best for: fast social ads using templates (Facebook/Instagram/TikTok/YouTube).
  - Strengths: huge template libraries, brand kits, easy resizing for platforms, stock media.
  - Limits: less advanced AI presenter/generative video features.

- Pictory
  - Best for: repurposing long content (blogs, webinars) into short social ads.
  - Strengths: auto-summarize, auto-caption, quick cuts, good for scaling repurposing.
  - Limits: template/visual options more limited than Canva.

- VEED / Kapwing
  - Best for: collaborative editing + AI helpers (auto-subtitles, script→video).
  - Strengths: simple editor, captioning, team features.
  - Limits: not aimed at photorealistic avatars or heavy generative effects.

How to pick the “best” for you
- Need an on‑screen spokesperson from a script → Synthesia/HeyGen/Elai.
- Want lots of templated social ads quickly and cheaply → Canva/InVideo/Promo.
- Need unique, generative visuals or advanced compositing → Runway.
- Repurposing long content into short ads → Pictory.
- Need team collaboration and subtitles/captions → VEED/Kapwing.

Quick buying checklist
- Output formats & platform aspect ratios (1:1, 9:16, 16:9)
- Voice & language support
- Brand kit (fonts, colors, logo)
- Stock media library & licensing for ads
- Export resolution / watermark policy
- Pricing model (credits vs minutes vs subscription)
- API or bulk/scale capabilities if you plan many ads

If you tell me: platform (TikTok, FB, YouTube), budget, whether you want an AI presenter or templates, and how many ads you need per month, I’ll recommend the single best tool and a simple workflow to create your first ad.
